address: Main Street, Clonegall, Y21 KH61, Ireland
bio: There is something so comforting about visiting this 17th-century former coaching inn. As you arrive, admire the pastoral setting with its picture-perfect bridge and meandering river. Once inside, you will be warmly welcomed by the team before being treated to cooking that often feels like the dictionary definition of 'hearty'. Substantial portions of rich, deeply flavoured dishes like slow-braised beef rib with Bourguignon-style sauce are sure to warm even the coldest of cockles. It all comes from quality local ingredients and a kitchen that knows how to use them....
